decks.notes: The deck is centered around assembling the combo of Doomsday and Thassa's Oracle to win the game. It includes a variety of card draw and selection spells such as Ponder and Brainstorm to set up the combo quickly. The deck also has disruption in the form of Force of Will and Flusterstorm to protect the combo from opposing interaction. With the ability to quickly assemble its win condition and protect it, this deck aims to win the game before the opponent can react effectively.

The focus of this deck is to generate a massive amount of mana quickly using cards like Grim Monolith and Mishra's Workshop, and then assemble the combo pieces of Coveted Jewel, The One Ring, and Paradoxical Outcome to gain maximum advantage and overpower the opponent. Through cards like Mana Crypt, Moxen, and powerful artifacts like Time Vault, players can untap and use their resources multiple times in a turn to create a dominant board state. With efficient card draw spells like Ancestral Recall and Force of Will for protection, this combo-based deck aims to win the game rapidly and decisively.

The deck focuses on assembling the Coveted Jewel combo with cards like The One Ring, Phyrexian Metamorph, and Paradoxical Outcome to generate mana and draw cards rapidly. It also utilizes powerful mana ramp options like Mishra's Workshop and mana rocks like Black Lotus and Moxen to quickly accelerate into its game-ending combo pieces like Time Vault and Karn, the Great Creator. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its explosive mana generation and card draw to take control of the game and win through a powerful combo finish.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful artifact-based combo using cards like Coveted Jewel, Paradoxical Outcome, Tinker, and Phyrexian Metamorph. By generating mana with Mishra's Workshop, Tolarian Academy, and mana rocks like Mana Crypt and Sol Ring, the deck aims to quickly amass resources to enable game-winning plays. Additionally, cards like Time Vault and Karn, the Great Creator provide alternate win conditions or disruption against opponents. The deck's strategy revolves around efficiently assembling and protecting its key pieces to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

The key strategy of this deck is to control the game by using counterspells, removal, card draw, and disruptive creatures. The deck aims to maintain board control and disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up its win conditions. It utilizes cards like Force of Will, Swords to Plowshares, and Lavinia, Azorius Renegade to handle threats, while also having access to powerful cards like Ancestral Recall and Time Walk for card advantage and extra turns. The deck is focused on outlasting opponents and gradually gaining an advantage to secure victory.

This deck focuses on deploying aggressive creatures while disrupting opponents with hate cards like Thorn of Amethyst and Trinisphere. The deck aims to control the board with creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Archon of Emeria, making it difficult for the opponent to cast spells efficiently. In addition, the deck utilizes cards like Swords to Plowshares for removal and Chalice of the Void for further disruption. With mana acceleration from Moxen and other fast mana sources, the deck can quickly establish its board presence and overwhelm opponents with its aggressive hatebear strategy.

The deck focuses on using Oath of Druids as a win condition to cheat out powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Bolas's Citadel. It also includes a suite of counterspells and disruption spells to control the game and protect its combo pieces. The inclusion of cards like Show and Tell and Tinker allows for additional ways to cheat out threats, while cards like Ancestral Recall and Brainstorm provide card advantage and selection. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while quickly assembling its own win condition.

The deck focuses on utilizing Oath of Druids to cheat powerful creatures into play, with Atraxa, Grand Unifier as the main win condition. The deck includes control elements such as Force of Will and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Show and Tell can also be used to put Atraxa into play. The deck includes additional support cards like Veil of Summer and Oko, Thief of Crowns for protection and disruption. Overall, the strategy revolves around quickly assembling the Oath combo and controlling the game until victory.

This deck focuses on utilizing the powerful combo of Underworld Breach with Brain Freeze to mill the opponent's library and win the game. It includes various control elements like Force of Will and Pyroblast to protect the combo pieces, along with card draw and tutor effects to assemble the combo quickly. The deck also includes key mana sources like Black Lotus and Moxen to generate additional resources and accelerate the game plan. The inclusion of cards like Tinker and Bolas's Citadel provide additional avenues for victory, making the deck versatile and resilient in Vintage 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on using artifact ramp and fast mana to quickly assemble the Coveted Jewel combo, allowing the player to draw their entire deck and win the game. The deck includes powerful cards like Tinker and Mystic Forge to help find key pieces, along with disruption like Force of Will to protect the combo. The use of Mishra's Workshop and Ancient Tomb provides additional acceleration, while cards like Manifold Key and Paradoxical Outcome help generate even more mana and draw power. Ultimately, the goal is to create a powerful and explosive win condition using artifacts and card advantage.

This deck focuses on using a combination of control elements and powerful spells to disrupt the opponent's strategy while slowly gaining resources and advantage. By utilizing Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion, the deck gains an additional recursion option for key cards. The deck includes a variety of card draw, disruption, removal, and win conditions to outmaneuver the opponent and assert dominance over the game. With a mix of efficient spells and resource denial, this Grixis Control deck aims to manipulate the game state in its favor and come out on top.

This deck focuses on assembling the Coveted Jewel combo as quickly and efficiently as possible, using powerful artifacts and spells such as Mishra's Workshop, Mana Crypt, and Paradoxical Outcome to generate mana and draw cards. The goal is to control the game with disruptive cards like Force of Will and Sink into Stupor until the combo can be assembled, allowing the player to gain a significant advantage and potentially win the game in a single turn. The deck also includes cards like Trinisphere and Karn, the Great Creator to disrupt the opponent's strategy and protect the combo.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling the Doomsday combo to win the game in a single turn. It utilizes cards like Black Lotus and Dark Ritual to generate mana quickly, while also running cards like Ancestral Recall and Brainstorm to dig for key combo pieces. The goal is to use Doomsday to stack the top of the library in a way that allows for a win condition using Thassa's Oracle. The deck also includes disruption in the form of counterspells like Force of Will and Flusterstorm to protect the combo.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game through various spells, counters, and removal while using Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion for additional value. The deck includes a mix of powerful control cards like Force of Will, along with mana acceleration from cards like Mox Jet and Black Lotus. By utilizing efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and countermagic like Spell Pierce, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while using card draw spells like Ancestral Recall to maintain card advantage and stay ahead in the game.

It includes a mix of counterspells, removal, and card draw to control the game and outvalue the opponent. The deck also utilizes its companion, Lurrus of the Dream-Den, to provide additional recurring threats and value. By efficiently managing resources and disrupting the opponent's strategy, the deck aims to grind out incremental advantages and eventually win the game through attrition.

The deck focuses on controlling the game using counterspells and disruptive cards while utilizing the Oath of Druids to cheat powerful creatures into play. The goal is to ramp into Atraxa, Grand Unifier or other impactful creatures quickly using acceleration from mana rocks and tutors like Demonic Tutor. Show and Tell can also be used to put a threat into play ahead of curve. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy, protect its own win conditions, and quickly close out the game with powerful threats.
